content: I need a box, that is on the upside open. The outer dimensions are 220 x 300 x 160mm. The wall thickness should be 8mm and the bottom thickness 12mm | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate inner dimensions\\nouter_x = 220\\nouter_y = 300\\nouter_z = 160\\nwall_thickness = 8\\nbottom_thickness = 12\\n\\ninner_x = outer_x - 2 * wall_thickness\\ninner_y = outer_y - 2 * wall_thickness\\ninner_z = outer_z - bottom_thickness\\n\\n# Calculate positions for the outer and inner boxes\\n# Outer box starts at (0, 0, 0)\\n# Inner box starts at (wall_thickness, wall_thickness, bottom_thickness)\\n\\nouter_box = {\\n    'x_size': [outer_x],\\n    'y_size': [outer_y],\\n    'z_size': [outer_z],\\n    'x': [0],\\n    'y': [0],\\n    'z': [0],\\n    'subtraction': [False]\\n}\\n\\ninner_box = {\\n    'x_size': [inner_x],\\n    'y_size': [inner_y],\\n    'z_size': [inner_z],\\n    'x': [wall_thickness],\\n    'y': [wall_thickness],\\n    'z': [bottom_thickness],\\n    'subtraction': [True]\\n}\\n\\n(outer_box, inner_box)\"}"

content:
{"PythonCode":"# Calculate inner dimensions
outer_x = 220
outer_y = 300
outer_z = 160
wall_thickness = 8
bottom_thickness = 12

inner_x = outer_x - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_y = outer_y - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_z = outer_z - bottom_thickness

# Calculate positions for the outer and inner boxes
# Outer box starts at (0, 0, 0)
# Inner box starts at (wall_thickness, wall_thickness, bottom_thickness)

outer_box = {
    'x_size': [outer_x],
    'y_size': [outer_y],
    'z_size': [outer_z],
    'x': [0],
    'y': [0],
    'z': [0],
    'subtraction': [False]
}

inner_box = {
    'x_size': [inner_x],
    'y_size': [inner_y],
    'z_size': [inner_z],
    'x': [wall_thickness],
    'y': [wall_thickness],
    'z': [bottom_thickness],
    'subtraction': [True]
}

(outer_box, inner_box)"}
